title: Relief Walk Service
content: Relief Walk is a quick visit service starting at $20 for approximately 15 minutes. This service is ideal for puppies, seniors, or busy days when your dog needs a quick bathroom break. The walker gives your dog a chance to stretch, breathe fresh air, and take care of business. It provides peace of mind knowing your dog gets outside when they need it most. Additional dogs from the same household add $5 per dog. Relief Walks are perfect for short-duration needs and ensuring your dog's comfort throughout the day. All walks are booked in 15-minute increments with a two-hour arrival window. Services are billed at $20 per 15-minute increment with tiered loyalty discounts available for Preferred Client Program members.

title: Signature Walk Service
content: Signature Walk is the most popular service starting at $32 for approximately 30 minutes. This walk keeps dogs happy, balanced, and engaged, providing enough time for movement, sniffing, and interaction to break up their day. Owners love it because their dog is calmer and more content when they return home. Additional dogs from the same household add $5 per dog. The Signature Walk is designed for daily exercise and mental stimulation, offering the perfect balance of activity and enrichment. It's ideal for mid-day relief for working professionals or as part of a regular exercise routine. All walks are booked in 15-minute increments with a two-hour arrival window. Services are billed at $20 per 15-minute increment with tiered loyalty discounts available for Preferred Client Program members.

title: Fitness Walk Service
content: Fitness Walk is designed for active dogs who thrive on exercise, starting at $44 for approximately 45 minutes. This service gives dogs the substantial physical activity they need to stay healthy and focused. More movement means less pent-up energy, fewer unwanted behaviors, and a happier pup. Owners notice the difference in how satisfied their dogs are afterward. Additional dogs from the same household add $5 per dog. The Fitness Walk is perfect for high-energy breeds or dogs that need more than a standard walk to feel fulfilled. It promotes canine wellness through extended exercise and exploration. All walks are booked in 15-minute increments with a two-hour arrival window. Services are billed at $20 per 15-minute increment with tiered loyalty discounts available for Preferred Client Program members.

title: Adventure Walk Service
content: Adventure Walk is an extended outing full of exploration and variety starting at $56 for approximately 60 minutes with transportation included. This is the highlight of your dog's day. With more time to roam, sniff, and enjoy the outdoors, it's perfect for curious or high-energy dogs. Dogs return home tired, fulfilled, and ready to rest. Additional dogs from the same household add $10 per dog. The Adventure Walk offers maximum enrichment and exercise, taking dogs to different locations for new experiences and sensory stimulation. It's ideal for dogs who need extensive physical and mental engagement. All walks are booked in 15-minute increments with a two-hour arrival window. Services are billed at $20 per 15-minute increment with tiered loyalty discounts available for Preferred Client Program members.

title: Pricing Structure
content: All Bethesda Dog Walkers services are billed at $20 per 15-minute increment. Relief Walk starts at $20 for approximately 15 minutes. Signature Walk starts at $32 for approximately 30 minutes. Fitness Walk starts at $44 for approximately 45 minutes. Adventure Walk starts at $56 for approximately 60 minutes with transportation included. Additional dogs from the same household add $5 per dog for Relief, Signature, and Fitness Walks, or $10 per dog for Adventure Walks. All walks are booked in 15-minute increments with a two-hour arrival window. Tiered loyalty discounts are available through the Preferred Client Program: Gold tier (3 walks per week) receives 10% off, Platinum tier (5 walks per week) receives 15% off, and Diamond tier (10+ walks per week) receives 20% off. Pre-paid packages are available for clients needing ad-hoc services, subject to the same pricing structures, and must be used within 6 months of purchase. Contact 301-265-DOGS (3647) for detailed pricing or to discuss package deals.

title: Preferred Client Program Overview
content: The Preferred Client Program offers exclusive benefits for clients choosing ongoing service of at least three weekly walks. Enrollment is automatic when you choose ongoing service of at least three weekly walks. New Preferred Clients receive three complimentary walks when enrolling in an ongoing service plan as a welcome gift. The program is designed to give clients and their dogs the very best experience through consistency, priority access, and exclusive services. The Preferred Client Program rewards families who rely on Bethesda Dog Walkers regularly, ensuring dependable care from familiar faces and guaranteed spots on the schedule. This program demonstrates the company's commitment to long-term relationships and exceptional ongoing care for both dogs and their owners.

title: Preferred Client Membership Tiers
content: The Preferred Client Program offers three membership tiers based on weekly frequency. Gold tier includes 3 walks per week with a 10% discount on all services. Platinum tier includes 5 walks per week with a 15% discount on all services. Diamond tier includes 10 or more walks per week with a 20% discount on all services. These frequency discounts apply to all ongoing services and reward clients for their commitment to regular care. The more frequently you use services, the greater the savings. All tiers include the full benefits of the Preferred Client Program including priority scheduling, greater consistency, progress reports, and exclusive service access. Discounts are automatically applied based on your weekly frequency and calculated during billing every four weeks.

title: Preferred Client Program Benefits
content: Preferred Client Program benefits include: Three Free Walks as a welcome gift when enrolling in ongoing service. Frequency Discounts with three membership tiers (Gold 10% off for 3 walks per week, Platinum 15% off for 5 walks per week, Diamond 20% off for 10+ walks per week). Priority Scheduling gives first choice of time slots so your dog's care always fits seamlessly into your day, with visits reserved and guaranteed, never worrying about last-minute availability. Greater Consistency means your dog sees the same familiar faces at the door, building trust and comfort with their walkers, with fewer visitors providing greater security and peace of mind at home. Progress Reports track your dog's behavior, energy, and habits over time, giving valuable insight into their well-being, helping spot trends, celebrate progress, and address changes early. Exclusive Services unlock access to add-on services like pet transportation and yard clean-up, ensuring every aspect of your dog's care is covered and making life easier for owners.

title: Mid-Day Walk Services
content: Mid-Day Walks are designed for clients who are back at work during the day. These walks provide peace of mind knowing your dog isn't stuck waiting for hours without relief. Mid-day walks ensure regular exercise, a bathroom break, and mental stimulation, helping dogs stay calmer and happier until you get home. This service breaks up the long daytime hours and prevents dogs from holding their bladder for extended periods, which is important for their health and comfort. Mid-day walks can be scheduled as Relief Walks (15 minutes), Signature Walks (30 minutes), Fitness Walks (45 minutes), or Adventure Walks (60 minutes) depending on your dog's needs and energy level. Consistent mid-day visits help establish routine and reduce anxiety in dogs who are home alone during work hours.

title: Morning and Evening Walk Services
content: Morning and Evening Walks offer two walks per day and are ideal for older clients or those dealing with mobility limitations. This service ensures dogs still get consistency, exercise, and bathroom breaks without requiring owners to manage these tasks themselves. Two walks per day is a simple way to make sure your dog stays happy and healthy while keeping daily routines manageable. This option is perfect for seniors, individuals with physical limitations, or anyone who finds it challenging to walk their dog twice daily. The morning walk starts the day right with exercise and bathroom relief, while the evening walk provides the same before bedtime. This service can use any combination of walk lengths (Relief, Signature, Fitness, or Adventure) based on what works best for your dog and schedule. It maintains your dog's routine and wellbeing while accommodating your needs.

title: As-Needed Services
content: As-Needed Services are designed for clients with unpredictable or rotating schedules. When shifts change week to week or days run long, Bethesda Dog Walkers adjusts so dogs still get consistent exercise, bathroom breaks, and attention. This service takes one more thing off your busy schedule and ensures your dog's routine stays steady even when your schedule doesn't. As-needed services are perfect for healthcare workers, shift workers, or anyone with variable work hours. You can book services through Time to Pet as your schedule becomes clear. While same-day requests are accepted when possible, exact time blocks or preferred staff members may not be guaranteed for last-minute bookings. Pre-paid packages are available for clients who need occasional ad-hoc services, providing flexibility without requiring a regular weekly commitment. These packages must be used within 6 months of purchase and follow the same pricing structure of $20 per 15-minute increment.

title: Time to Pet Software System
content: Bethesda Dog Walkers uses Time to Pet, an industry-leading scheduling software, to manage over 20,000 visits per year. This comprehensive platform handles all scheduling, communication, billing, and visit documentation. Every walk includes a detailed post-visit report through Time to Pet featuring: a timestamp of arrival and departure showing exact visit timing, a written overview describing what happened during the visit, relevant highlights noting anything important or unusual, photos and videos of your dog during the walk, and a GPS report showing exactly where your dog was walked with the route mapped. These reports provide transparency and help owners feel connected and confident about their pets' wellbeing while in care. Clients can access Time to Pet through the web portal at timetopet.com/portal/bethesdadogwalkers or download the Time to Pet mobile app for on-the-go access. All scheduling requests, cancellations, and communication with the Admin Team should be handled through the Time to Pet platform.

title: Visit Documentation and Reports
content: Every single walk with Bethesda Dog Walkers includes comprehensive documentation through Time to Pet. The company never phones it in and prides itself on having a reputation for excellent communication. Each post-visit report includes: Arrival and departure timestamps showing exactly when the walker arrived and left your home. A written overview providing details about the visit, how your dog behaved, bathroom activities, and any observations. Relevant highlights noting anything important such as changes in behavior, appetite, energy levels, or any concerns. Photos and videos capturing your dog during the walk, showing them enjoying their time outside. A GPS report with a mapped route showing exactly where your dog was walked, providing transparency about the distance covered and areas explored. This level of documentation ensures owners always know what happened during each visit and can track their dog's wellbeing over time, spot patterns, and feel confident their dog is receiving excellent care even when they're not home.

title: Scheduling and Communication Procedures
content: All scheduling for Bethesda Dog Walkers must be routed through the Admin Team and requested via Time to Pet or the Time to Pet mobile app. This is a critical policy: Do NOT call, text, or leave written notes for your dog walker. Instead, contact the Admin Team with all questions and special requests. This ensures clear communication, proper scheduling, and that all requests are properly documented and handled. The Admin Team can be reached at 301-265-DOGS (3647) or admin@bethesdadogwalkers.com during office hours (Monday through Friday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, weekends and evenings by appointment). Last-minute and same-day services can be requested and are accepted when possible, though exact time blocks or preferred staff members may not be guaranteed for same-day requests. All walks are booked in 15-minute increments with a two-hour arrival window. New clients must first schedule a free meet and greet consultation at bethesdadogwalkers.com/book before regular services can begin.

title: Meet and Greet Consultation Policy
content: All new clients are required to complete a complimentary initial consultation before services can begin. This meet and greet is mandatory but completely free of charge. During the consultation, your primary dog walker will get acquainted with you and your dog, review your client and pet profiles created in Time to Pet, discuss your dog's routine, preferences, personality, and any special needs, and collect a functioning home key or garage code for access during visits. This initial meeting ensures the walker understands your dog's specific requirements and that you feel comfortable with the care provider entering your home. Schedule your free meet and greet at bethesdadogwalkers.com/book or by calling 301-265-DOGS (3647). Important garage code policy: If you provide a garage code for entry instead of a key, you are responsible for any missed visits due to malfunction or power outage. If a locksmith must be employed to gain entry to the premises due to malfunction, power outage, or other garage code issues, you will be responsible for reimbursing Bethesda Dog Walkers for costs incurred.

title: Cancellation Policy
content: Bethesda Dog Walkers has a clear and fair cancellation policy. Cancellations made the day before the scheduled visit (until 11:59 PM) incur absolutely no charge and can be cancelled freely. Same-day cancellations are billed in full with no refund or credit. To cancel services, login to your Time to Pet account either through the web portal or mobile app and select the specific walks you need to cancel. Do not contact dog walkers directly for cancellations. All cancellation requests must be submitted through the Time to Pet system to ensure proper processing. This policy allows the company to properly schedule staff and ensures that clients who need services can be accommodated in available slots. For assistance with cancellations or questions about the policy, contact the Admin Team at 301-265-DOGS (3647) or admin@bethesdadogwalkers.com during office hours Monday through Friday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

title: Payment and Billing Information
content: Bethesda Dog Walkers accepts credit cards and ACH (preferred method) for payment. All payments are processed through the Time to Pet platform for security and convenience. Billing is processed every four weeks from the day you start service, creating a regular billing cycle. No deposit is required when booking services online or through the app. Services are billed at the base rate of $20 per 15-minute increment, with applicable loyalty discounts automatically applied for Preferred Client Program members based on their tier (Gold 10% off, Platinum 15% off, Diamond 20% off). Pre-paid packages are available for clients needing occasional ad-hoc services rather than ongoing regular schedules. These packages are subject to the same pricing structures and must be used within 6 months of purchase. Clients can view their billing history, upcoming charges, and payment methods through their Time to Pet account. For questions about billing, invoices, or payment methods, contact admin@bethesdadogwalkers.com or call 301-265-DOGS (3647) during office hours.

If you are not pleased with your dog walking and enrichment membership within the first four weeks, you will receive a full refund for all services rendered during that period. This guarantee functions similar to a trial period and demonstrates the company's confidence in service quality and commitment to client satisfaction. Because Bethesda Dog Walkers is so confident that you and your dog will be delighted by the services, this risk-free guarantee allows new clients to experience the Bethesda Dog Walkers difference without financial commitment. This policy shows the company's commitment to excellence and willingness to stand behind their reputation for exceptional, reliable service.

title: Staff and Team Structure
content: Bethesda Dog Walkers operates as a fully team-based service rather than assigning one single walker to each client. Most clients enjoy seeing a few regular walkers to ensure services are never interrupted due to illness, vacation, or scheduling conflicts. The company strives to limit the number of assigned staff to each client to maintain familiarity and consistency while ensuring backup coverage is always available. This team approach means your dog builds relationships with multiple trusted caregivers rather than relying on just one person. All staff members are background checked, certified in Pet First Aid and CPR, and extensively trained in dog health, behavior, and safety. The team is highly trained and trusted, treating every dog with exceptional care. Preferred Client Program members receive greater consistency with even more limited staff rotation. While you may not have the exact same walker every single time, you will see familiar faces regularly who know your dog well and can provide seamless, consistent care.

title: Home Entry and Security Policies
content: Bethesda Dog Walkers has strict policies regarding home entry and security. Dog walkers are instructed not to allow anyone entry into your home during visits under any circumstances. This protects your home security and ensures only authorized Bethesda Dog Walkers staff enter your property. As a courtesy to the team and for safety reasons, please let the Admin Team know if anyone will be at home during scheduled visits (such as remote workers, family members, houseguests). Dog walkers cannot provide access to other service providers such as house cleaners, repair workers, contractors, or delivery personnel. If you need to grant access to another service provider, you must make separate arrangements directly with that provider. Dog walkers will not answer the door, accept packages (unless pre-arranged), or interact with anyone attempting to enter your home. This policy ensures the safety of both your home and the dog walking staff while maintaining the security you expect from a professional service.

title: Household Changes and Updates
content: Besides the initial meet and greet consultation, clients sometimes need to update their information due to household changes. If you get a new pet, change your locks, move to a new address within the service area, change your garage code, or have other significant changes, there are two options for updating this information. Option 1: Schedule a regular dog walking visit slot for the walker to stop by in person to review changes, meet new pets, test new keys or codes, and update procedures. This is billed as a regular walk. Option 2: Review instructions via phone or email with the Admin Team at no charge. Client profiles can be updated through Time to Pet at no charge for information changes that don't require an in-person visit. For new pets, new locks, or significant routine changes, an in-person visit is recommended to ensure smooth service continuation. Contact the Admin Team at 301-265-DOGS (3647) or admin@bethesdadogwalkers.com to discuss the best approach for your specific situation.

title: Pack Walks and Socialization Policy
content: Bethesda Dog Walkers only offers pack walks occasionally and on a very limited basis. At this time, the company only provides private walks for dogs from within the same household. Multiple dogs from the same family can be walked together with additional dog pricing ($5 per additional dog for most walks, $10 per additional dog for Adventure Walks). The company does not currently offer group pack walks with dogs from different households. This ensures focused attention on your dog, maintains safety and control, and provides a personalized experience tailored to your dog's specific needs and pace. If your dog(s) may benefit from a socialization session or you are interested in discussing pack walk possibilities, please contact the Admin Team at 301-265-DOGS (3647) or admin@bethesdadogwalkers.com to discuss the details and see what options might be available for your specific situation. title: Service Customization and Personalization
content: Every service provided by Bethesda Dog Walkers is customized to suit each dog's breed, age, and individual needs. The company recognizes that different dogs have vastly different requirements based on multiple factors. Breed considerations include energy levels (high-energy breeds like Border Collies need more intensive exercise than lower-energy breeds), size and physical capabilities (large dogs have different pacing than small dogs), breed-specific health concerns (brachycephalic breeds need different exercise approaches), and temperament characteristics. Age considerations include puppies requiring shorter, more frequent outings with bathroom focus, adult dogs in their prime needing substantial exercise and enrichment, and senior dogs needing gentler pacing with joint-friendly routes and bathroom accommodations. Individual needs address each dog's unique personality, preferences, fears or anxieties, social behavior with other dogs and people, specific behavioral training being reinforced, medical conditions requiring accommodation, and physical limitations or injuries. This individualized approach ensures every dog receives exactly the care they need rather than a one-size-fits-all service, maximizing the benefit and enjoyment of each walk.

title: Fitness and Enrichment Focus
content: Bethesda Dog Walkers emphasizes that services provide both physical fitness and canine enrichment, going beyond basic walking to deliver comprehensive wellness benefits. Physical fitness components include cardiovascular exercise appropriate to the dog's fitness level, muscle development and maintenance through varied terrain and pacing, joint health through regular movement, weight management through consistent calorie burn, and stamina building in athletic or working breeds. Canine enrichment addresses mental stimulation through exploration of different routes and environments, sensory engagement with opportunities to smell, hear, and see new things, social interaction when appropriate for the individual dog, behavioral satisfaction by allowing natural dog behaviors like sniffing and investigating, and stress relief through physical activity and outdoor time. The combination of fitness and enrichment means dogs aren't just getting exercise - they're having fulfilling experiences that address their physical and psychological needs. This holistic approach results in happier, healthier, better-behaved dogs who are calmer and more content at home. The enrichment focus differentiates Bethesda Dog Walkers from services that simply provide mechanical exercise without attention to the dog's mental and emotional experience.

These clients expect the gold standard in pet care and are willing to invest in premium services that deliver reliability, consistency, safety, and genuine care for their beloved dogs.

The company's money-back guarantee (full refund if not satisfied within first four weeks) demonstrates confidence in reliability and quality. title: Walking Routes and Locations
content: Bethesda Dog Walkers provides walks in safe, appropriate locations throughout the service area. For Relief, Signature, and Fitness Walks, dogs are typically walked in their own neighborhood, around their home area, or to nearby parks and green spaces depending on what's available and appropriate for the individual dog. The GPS tracking feature in every visit report shows the exact route taken, providing transparency about where your dog walked. Adventure Walks include transportation, meaning walkers can take dogs to special locations beyond the immediate neighborhood such as larger parks, trails, or other enriching environments that provide variety and new experiences. The specific route for each walk is chosen based on the dog's needs, energy level, and preferences. High-energy dogs might walk longer distances or use routes with more terrain variation. Senior dogs might take gentler, shorter routes with fewer stairs or hills. Nervous dogs might avoid busy streets in favor of quieter areas. The GPS reports allow owners to see exactly where their dog went, ensuring accountability and allowing them to confirm appropriate routes were chosen. Walkers are trained to avoid hazards, manage traffic safely, and choose routes that maximize the dog's exercise and enrichment experience.

title: Weather and Seasonal Considerations
content: While the website does not explicitly detail weather policies, Bethesda Dog Walkers operates year-round and accommodates Maryland's varied weather conditions. The company provides services in all four seasons, adjusting walks as needed for weather. Services continue in rain, snow, heat, and cold, with appropriate precautions and accommodations for extreme conditions. Dog walkers are trained to recognize when weather poses safety risks and adjust accordingly - shortening walks in extreme heat or cold, ensuring proper hydration in summer, watching for ice hazards in winter, and protecting dogs from severe weather. The service operates throughout all seasons because dogs need exercise and bathroom breaks regardless of weather. However, walk duration or route may be modified in extreme conditions to prioritize the dog's safety and comfort. Clients who have specific preferences about weather policies (for example, preferring shorter walks in rain or skipping walks in certain conditions) can communicate these preferences through their client profile in Time to Pet or discuss with the Admin Team. The GPS reports and visit documentation provide transparency about actual walk duration and route in any weather condition.

title: Emergency Protocols and Procedures
content: Bethesda Dog Walkers maintains professional emergency protocols to handle unexpected situations during walks. All staff members are certified in Pet First Aid and CPR, enabling immediate response to medical emergencies. If a dog shows signs of injury, illness, or distress during a walk, the walker is trained to assess the situation and take appropriate action. For serious emergencies, walkers will contact the client immediately and transport the dog to the veterinary clinic specified in the client profile, or to the nearest emergency vet if the situation is critical. The company maintains liability insurance covering emergency situations. Walkers carry client contact information and emergency vet details for every dog. The Time to Pet system includes emergency contact fields and special instructions that walkers can reference during visits. Clients should ensure their profile includes their preferred veterinary clinic, emergency vet information, and clear authorization for emergency treatment if they cannot be reached immediately. While emergencies are rare, the professional training, insurance coverage, and clear protocols ensure walkers can respond effectively if issues arise. The visit documentation system ensures any incidents are immediately reported and recorded.

title: Special Needs and Medical Accommodations
content: Bethesda Dog Walkers accommodates dogs with special needs and medical requirements through customized service approaches. The company offers Medication Administration as an additional service, ensuring dogs receive necessary medications during visits according to their prescribed schedule. For dogs with medical conditions such as diabetes, arthritis, heart conditions, or other health issues, walk intensity, duration, and route are adjusted to accommodate their limitations while still providing beneficial activity. Senior dogs receive gentler walks with appropriate pacing, shorter distances if needed, bathroom break focus, and routes avoiding steep hills or stairs. Dogs recovering from surgery or injury can receive modified walks as directed by veterinary instructions, progressing gradually as healing allows. Puppies receive age-appropriate short walks focused on socialization and bathroom training rather than intensive exercise. Dogs with anxiety or behavioral issues can be accommodated with patient, understanding walkers trained in dog behavior. The client profile in Time to Pet should include all medical conditions, medications, mobility limitations, behavioral concerns, and special instructions. This information ensures every walker assigned to your dog understands and accommodates their specific needs, providing safe, appropriate, beneficial care.

title: Multi-Dog Household Services
content: Bethesda Dog Walkers accommodates multi-dog households with flexible service options. Dogs from the same household can be walked together or separately based on their needs and the owner's preference. Walking dogs together costs $5 per additional dog for Relief, Signature, and Fitness Walks, or $10 per additional dog for Adventure Walks. This makes professional dog walking affordable even for households with multiple dogs. However, dogs don't have to be walked together if their needs differ significantly. For example, if one dog needs a long Fitness Walk while another senior dog needs only a brief Relief Walk, separate walks can be scheduled. If one dog has behavioral issues that make group walking challenging, individual walks can be arranged. The walker will discuss the best approach during the meet and greet consultation. Dogs who walk well together can enjoy the social aspect and efficiency of combined walks. Dogs with different needs can receive individualized attention. The service is customized to work best for your specific dogs rather than forcing all household dogs into the same service structure. Multi-dog households are common and well-accommodated within the service model.

title: Service Comparison and Choosing the Right Walk
content: Choosing between the four walk options depends on your dog's needs, energy level, age, and schedule. Relief Walk (15 min, $20) is best for quick bathroom breaks, puppies who can't handle long walks yet, senior dogs who tire easily, or adding a third visit on especially long days. Signature Walk (30 min, $32) is the most popular option, providing balanced exercise and enrichment for most dogs as a regular daily walk, suitable for adult dogs with moderate energy, ideal for mid-day breaks during work hours. Fitness Walk (45 min, $44) is designed for active breeds or high-energy dogs who need substantial exercise, working breeds that require more activity, or dogs working on fitness and weight management. Adventure Walk (60 min, $56 with transportation) is perfect for very high-energy dogs, curious dogs who love exploration, weekends when you want to give your dog something special, or dogs who benefit from varied environments and new experiences. Many clients use different services for different days - perhaps Signature Walks on weekdays and an Adventure Walk on weekends. The Preferred Client Program discounts make regular service more affordable (Gold 10% off, Platinum 15% off, Diamond 20% off). During the meet and greet, the walker can help recommend the best service mix for your specific dog based on their assessment of the dog's energy, age, and needs.

title: Client Portal and Time to Pet Features
content: The Time to Pet client portal at timetopet.com/portal/bethesdadogwalkers provides comprehensive account management and visit tracking. Clients can access the portal via web browser or download the Time to Pet mobile app for on-the-go access. Through the portal, clients can schedule new walks and recurring services by selecting dates, times, and service types. They can view upcoming scheduled visits to track when the walker will arrive. They can cancel visits following the cancellation policy (free cancellation until 11:59 PM the day before, same-day cancellations billed in full). After each visit, clients receive detailed post-visit reports including timestamp of arrival and departure, written overview of the visit, photos and videos of their dog, and GPS map showing where the dog was walked. Clients can manage their account information, update pet profiles with medical information or special instructions, view billing history and upcoming charges, manage payment methods (credit card or ACH), and communicate with the Admin Team. The portal provides transparency and control, allowing clients to manage their service entirely online. The documentation features create a log of every visit, allowing clients to track their dog's care over time and ensuring accountability. The mobile app provides convenience for busy professionals to manage their dog's care from anywhere.

title: Key and Access Management
content: Bethesda Dog Walkers requires either a functioning home key or garage code to access your property for dog walking services. During the mandatory meet and greet consultation, you will provide one of these access methods to your primary walker. If providing a physical key, the walker will maintain secure possession of the key, which is labeled with a system that does not identify your address (for security if the key is lost). Keys are kept secure and never shared outside the Bethesda Dog Walkers team. If providing a garage code instead of a key, important policy considerations apply: You are responsible for any missed visits due to garage door malfunction or power outage. If a locksmith must be employed to gain entry due to garage code issues, malfunction, or power outage, you are responsible for reimbursing Bethesda Dog Walkers for costs incurred. For this reason, providing a physical key may be more reliable than depending solely on a garage code system. If you change locks, move to a new home within the service area, or change your garage code, you must update the walker by either scheduling an in-person visit (billed as a regular walk) or contacting the Admin Team to arrange key exchange or code update. Proper access management ensures walkers can reliably enter your home to provide scheduled services without delays or missed visits.
